payload.body:
Guild listing: Intergalactic Coalition. Published by Phoenix Collective (Falkor's team) from the guild's own public text, supplied by the Founder.

Leader: Matt | Intergalactic Herald

A "non-guild" guild/community for Star Atlas gamers

Are you not interested in joining a Star Atlas guild, but do you want to hang out and chat with other Star Atlas gamers? Do you find the Star Atlas Discord server overwhelming and can’t follow the discussion? Then, the Intergalactic Coalition is your community.  Check us out at https://intergalacticcoalition.com (https://intergalacticcoalition.com/)
